neighbours.label: someone being picked as a winner or honoree: the moment of selection in contests, giveaways and awards (the other side of the + pole's not-selected and missed-chance contexts)
fire: Entries close on Friday, and the winner will be picked at random.
If nobody claims the prize in a week, another winner will be drawn.
The judges will choose three finalists from the submitted essays.
Readers voted, and the magazine has crowned its winners for this year.
The foundation is honoring a local teacher with its top award.
After a long final round, the host named Priya the champion.
Our editor explains why she picked these five stories as her selections.
One commenter will be chosen to receive a free signed copy.
quiet: Stores close on Friday, and the shipment will be packed at noon.
If nobody pays the invoice in a week, another notice will be mailed.
The workers will clear three fields from the flooded estate.
Readers wrote in, and the magazine has fixed its errors for this year.
The foundation is funding a local clinic with its spare money.
After a long final meeting, the host thanked everyone for coming.
Our editor explains why she moved these five stories to the back.
One customer will be asked to return a faulty power cable.

notes: Peaks on ' be' before chosen/drawn and on selection verbs. The + pole fires on 'didn't get', 'non-selection' and 'second chance'.
